description: Co-op with AI buddies offline (Mike, 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17, T-NETWORKING-007): the original's one-player co-op from the offline Room's Campaign tab. It waits for the title and for Agent Select (readiness, not fixed times: base 9 boots in about 1:52), loads a staged agent through Agent Select, walks the real Main Menu and Play graph into Combat Simulator (the offline Room), opens on the Campaign tab (--debug-room-tab campaign) and fires the Room's own Start Match (--debug-auto-start-match) with Defection on Agent and the Partner choice at 2 simulants (--coop-ai-buddies 2). The start goes through the mission start Solo Missions uses (menuhandlerAcceptMission) with one player and the buddies, clamped to the original's limit: the staged agent has no co-op completions, so one buddy. The buddy spawns at the player (playerTick, GAILIST_INIT_DEFAULT_BUDDY), the mission plays to its debug end at 40 s (--debug-end-mission, every objective complete) and the results show, with no menu or input watchdog repair. Written 2026-11-17.

input_sequence.comment: Boot and extraction done; the title's legal screen is up (script time waits here, so a slow boot does not shift the taps).

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: On the PD logo (the legal, Rare and Nintendo screens take about 12.6 s): leave the title for Agent Select.
Agent Select is the current menu and takes input. One second after the tap: a wait cannot begin while a tap is still held (pending_tap).

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: Activate the only staged JSON profile and enter the live Main Menu.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_MENU_UP
input_sequence.comment: Clamp restored Main Menu focus to the first Play row without assuming persisted cursor state.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_MENU_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: Move from Solo Missions to Combat Simulator in the Play subview.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: Open the real offline Room; it opens on the Campaign tab and its one-shot Start Match fires once that tab is shown.
The co-op mission live and controllable, with one bounded Skip if the authored intro owns input.
The results, after --debug-end-mission ends the mission at 40 s.
Scripted clean exit 4 s (script time) after the results.

required_lines: COOP\.AIBUDDIES: offline start stage=base:defection stageindex=0 difficulty=0 buddies=1 requested=2 max=1
forbidden_patterns: COOP\.AIBUDDIES: offline start (has no stage|: .* is not a campaign mission)
NET: weapon [0-9]+ .* has no session catalog id
NET: model [0-9]+ .* has no session catalog id
